title: Phase 1 W1 — wood-frame wall with 25 mm EPS exterior insulation
jurisdiction: NRC Field Exposure of Walls facility, Ottawa, Ontario, Canada (research specimen; no permit jurisdiction)
code_edition: Unknown; the study reports NBC references but not a project’s adopted edition.

facts.text: The six specimens were 1,219 x 1,829 mm (4 x 6 ft) wall sections tested at NRC’s Ottawa FEWF; Phase 1 used common 12.7 mm interior drywall, 6-mil polyethylene air/vapour layer, 2x6 framing with R-24 glass-fibre batt, and 11 mm OSB.
W1 adds 25 mm EPS (reported overall R-27) with sheathing membrane, furring and vinyl siding to the common Phase 1 wall.
The report describes approximately nine months of monitored Phase 1 exposure and instrumentation at multiple wall layers.
No condensation was observed in any Phase 1 specimen during monitoring or teardown; the result applies only to the reported test period and assembly.

limitations: The report is a laboratory/field-exposure research study; results do not establish performance of another wall or code acceptance.
